info.title: SkillBridge API
info.description: REST API for CV analysis, skill gap analysis, career matching, learning roadmaps, opportunities, and user progress tracking.

post.description: Generates and saves career matches for the authenticated user using the latest completed skill-gap analysis and currently active opportunities. Existing matches for the same user and opportunity are updated rather than duplicated. Results are returned in descending match-percentage order.

400.description: No completed skill-gap analysis exists, or the user's skill-gap analysis contains no current skills.

get.description: Retrieves completed career matches belonging to the authenticated user, including only matches whose opportunities are currently active. Results are ordered by match percentage, highest first.

get.description: Downloads the specified CV file belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a student account. The password is hashed before storage, and the new account is initially unverified.
Authenticates a user and returns their profile and a JWT valid for seven days.
Requests a six-digit password reset code. The code expires after ten minutes. The same success message is returned whether or not an account exists for the supplied email address.
Checks the reset code against the stored hash, expiry, and attempt limit.

Resets the password when the supplied code is valid and has not expired. The new password must contain at least eight characters. A successful reset clears the stored reset code and resets the failed-attempt counter.

400.description: Required fields are missing or the new password is too short.
